question: How is this subject understood as luminous by nature yet contracted into twofold objects?
premises: The subject has an own nature of light.
It is further considered through contraction.
The contraction is into twofold objects.
inference: This subject is regarded as inherently luminous while appearing contracted into twofold objects.
uncertainties: dvidhārtha may refer to subject-object or another twofold division.
plain_english: By its own nature as light, this one is again considered as contracted into twofold objects.
